about: SO4 spaces for the lux grid (rects from THORNBECK_SPACES in src/world/maps/thornbeckMill.ts; PLAN section 3 "Spaces, levels and lamps"). No standard applies to a storm-dark mill: bands are null. The grid reads the pre-EMP field (lamps lit, no flash, no torch); the dark / flash checks live in tests/thornbeckMillLight.test.ts.

spaces.name: Start bay
spaces.type: Mill floor (night, lamps on before the EMP)
spaces.why: no maintained-lux band: the storm scene is dark by design (ambient 0; the lamps die at the EMP); read the levels and the meter-height dark share, not a pass / fail
